h1: The Capital Hotel Roi Et — A Central Budget Hotel That's Clean and Walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai
intro: If you're after a wallet-friendly place to stay in central Roi Et that still keeps rooms clean, The Capital Hotel comes up again and again in reviews for value. It's a 3-star hotel on Suriyadetbamrung Road in the Nai Mueang subdistrict, about a 15-minute walk from Bueng Phlan Chai and Roi Et Tower, and close to the Roi Et aquarium. There are 68 rooms ranging from Single to Deluxe and Suite, with breakfast included and free parking, starting from around ฿650/night. Real guest reviews agree the rooms are clean, the staff are helpful, and it's great value for a central stay — even if the building isn't new and there are a few things to accept.

body.html: The Capital Hotel is a 68-room, 3-star hotel in central Roi Et on Suriyadetbamrung Road in the Nai Mueang subdistrict. It opened back in 2013, so the building isn't brand new — but what keeps its name on the city's budget-hotel shortlist is that the rooms stay clean and rates start in the few-hundred-baht range. Room types run from Single and Deluxe Twin to Deluxe Double and a Suite, suiting solo travellers, couples and small families watching their budget.

What guests consistently praise is that the rooms are clean with daily housekeeping, and the front-desk staff are kind and helpful even if their English is limited. Every room has air-con, a fridge, TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi, and some have a balcony or a little table-and-chairs corner with a view. There's an on-site cafe and restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and laundry service. Breakfast is included in the rate — for a few-hundred-baht central stay, you get a genuinely usable set of basics.
"Clean room, comfortable bed, even a table and chairs to sit and look at the view. It's central so you can walk to Bueng Phlan Chai, staff were helpful — really good value at this price."

Location is another strong point. The hotel sits in central Roi Et, about a 15-minute walk to Bueng Phlan Chai (Somdet Park) and Roi Et Tower, the city's observation tower, and close to the Roi Et aquarium. Around the hotel you'll find a hospital, 7-Eleven and Watsons convenience stores, and plenty of restaurants, so food and essentials are easy. Free parking makes it handy for self-drivers or anyone breaking up an Isan road trip.

To be straight with you, based on real reviews: the things most often mentioned are noisy and inconsistent air-conditioning in some rooms, low shower water pressure, and occasionally slow Wi-Fi. Breakfast is a small buffet leaning Asian, with limited choices, so many guests head out to eat in town instead. A few reviewers were initially given a room in poorer condition and were moved after asking. And because the building opened in 2013, some fittings show their age.

Bottom line: if you want a budget hotel in central Roi Et that's clean, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai, includes breakfast, and you don't mind that the building isn't new — The Capital Hotel is a sensible pick. Its 7.6 from 20 Trip.com reviews and 3.9/5 on TripAdvisor reflect it well: clean rooms, good location, strong value, with minor caveats on air-con, water and the building's age. It suits people visiting Bueng Phlan Chai, going up Roi Et Tower, temple-hopping, or stopping one night on an Isan trip on a budget.

A tip from following the reviews here: at check-in, ask for a higher floor or a room away from the street — it cuts down noise from neighbouring air-con units and early-morning sounds outside. Check the air-con and hot water before you unpack, and ask to switch rooms if anything's off. For breakfast, if you want more variety, head out to a local breakfast spot or coffee shop near Bueng Phlan Chai for a morning meal the way locals do it.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Capital Hotel Roi Et

faq.q: Where is The Capital Hotel in Roi Et, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Capital Hotel is at 166/10 Suriyadetbamrung Road, Nai Mueang, in central Roi Et. It's about a 15-minute walk to Bueng Phlan Chai and Roi Et Tower (the observation tower), and close to the Roi Et aquarium. Around the hotel you'll find a hospital, 7-Eleven and Watsons stores, and restaurants — food and essentials are easy.

faq.q: How much does The Capital Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Single Room. Deluxe Twin, Deluxe Double and Suite rooms run roughly ฿750–฿1,050. Prices vary by room type and date, so always compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does The Capital Hotel include breakfast?
faq.a: Yes, breakfast is included — a small buffet leaning Asian, with fairly limited choices. Many guests head out to a local breakfast spot or coffee shop near Bueng Phlan Chai for more variety. Check at booking time that your package includes breakfast.

faq.q: Who is The Capital Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a budget hotel in central Roi Et that's clean, walkable to Bueng Phlan Chai, and don't mind that the building isn't new. It suits solo travellers, couples, small families and self-drivers who want free parking — ideal for visiting Bueng Phlan Chai, going up Roi Et Tower, or a one-night stop on an Isan trip on a budget.

faq.q: Are the rooms clean and good value?
faq.a: Most reviews confirm the rooms are clean with daily housekeeping and very good value for a central stay. Worth knowing: the building opened in 2013 so some fittings show their age, air-con can be noisy in some rooms, and shower water pressure is on the low side — so check the room's condition on arrival.

faq.q: Is there parking at The Capital Hotel for self-drivers?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel has free parking, handy for self-drivers or anyone breaking up an Isan road trip. It's a central-city area with convenience stores and restaurants within walking distance.
